lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity white spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a prominent column of five distinct spots located immediately behind the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of circular spots to create a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a bright upper edge and a distinct shadow line beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, light-colored spots is visible within the mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered towards the leading edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance white mark or scar is visible on the distal portion of the lower caudal fin lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The snout region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more compact spots compared to the larger, more spaced-out blobs on the lateral flank.
